sources.notes: Converted from official SEC EDGAR HTML exhibit (press release text + full financial tables) to Markdown; narrative and table content preserved verbatim, only markup stripped.

quarter_label_mismatch.evidence: SEC 8-K filed 2026-09-02 explicitly titled Third Quarter Fiscal Year 2026; fiscal quarter ended 2026-08-02.
quarter_label_mismatch.root_cause: raw_event_upcoming_earnings.csv event name literally embedded the wrong "FY2026 Q1" text; AVGO/HPE were missing from KNOWN_US_FISCAL_YEAR_START_MONTH in skills/skill-stock-fiscal-quarter-resolve, so update_readme() could not override the bad CSV label. Fixed by registering AVGO/HPE with fiscal-year-start-month=11.
quarter_label_mismatch.side_effect: The wrong FY2026 Q1 label also caused the >50-day invited-conference heuristic to misclassify this event as 受邀法說 instead of 法說會; corrected once the fiscal quarter resolves to Q3.
